info.title: TARCZA Documents API
info.description: Quotes, invoices, credit notes, payments, events and webhooks of the Documents application (InvoiceShelf fork). Superset of the contract kit file documents.v1.yaml (contracts 1.2). Calls made with an integration token (abilities documents:*, events:read, webhooks:manage; see POST /integration-tokens) get the representation described here; the web UI keeps the native InvoiceShelf shapes on the same paths. Every call needs the token; the company is taken from the token. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json with a stable `code`.

200.description: replay of an idempotent request or existing external_ref
same external_ref returns the existing payment

get.description: Owner with a full-access session only.

post.description: Owner with a full-access session only. The token is shown once.

get.summary: Business prefix and next number per document type
get.description: Numbers are `<PREFIX>-<TYPE>-YYYY-NNNNNN`, gap-free per company, type and year. Owner with a session or full-access token only; scoped integration tokens get 403.

put.summary: Set the business prefix and continue existing sequences
put.description: Owner with a session or full-access token only. `next` can only move a counter up (a value at or below the last issued number answers 422), so a number is never reused; unknown type codes and malformed prefixes answer 422.

get.description: Issued invoices and credit notes with totals; `manifest.signature` is v1,base64(HMAC-SHA256 of the manifest JSON).

customer.description: creates the customer when customer_ref is source:id and unknown

kind.description: accounting hint carried in document.issued (default other); invoices only

invoice_id.description: quotes: the invoice issued from them; credit notes: the credited invoice

last_issued.description: highest number issued for the year (0 = none)

next_number.description: the exact number the next document gets, e.g. TDS-INV-2026-000001; null while no prefix is set

series.description: per document type: EST estimates, INV invoices, CN credit notes

prefix.description: applies to documents numbered afterwards; issued numbers never change

year.description: year the `next` values apply to (default: current year, Africa/Johannesburg)

next.description: continue an existing sequence: the next document of that type gets this number
